name: Invitation to book a meeting
description: Sent to clients when you invite a client to pick a time.
subject: {{ advisor_first_name }} would like to set up a meeting

name: Booking request declined
description: Sent to clients when you decline a booking request.
subject: An update on your meeting request

name: Invitation to rebook a meeting
description: Sent to clients when a meeting needs a new time.
subject: Choose a new time for your meeting

name: Reschedule request declined
description: Sent to clients when you decline a reschedule request.
subject: An update on your requested time

name: Change notice
description: Sent to clients when the event type changes before a time is picked. The booking link stays the same.
subject: An update to the meeting you're booking

name: Cancellation with message
description: Sent to clients when you cancel a meeting with a message.
subject: A message about your meeting with {{ advisor_first_name }}

name: Reminder to book a meeting
description: Sent to clients when a client hasn't booked yet.
subject: A reminder to book your meeting

name: New request awaiting approval
description: Sent to you when a request needs your approval.
subject: Action needed: {{ client_name }} requested {{ request_summary }} — {{ event_type_name }}, {{ date }}, {{ time }}

name: New booking notification
description: Sent to you when a client books without approval.
subject: New booking: {{ client_name }} — {{ event_type_name }}, {{ date }}, {{ time }}

name: Rescheduling notification
description: Sent to you when a client reschedules.
subject: Rescheduled: {{ client_name }} moved your meeting to {{ date }}, {{ time }}

name: Cancellation notification
description: Sent to you when a client cancels on the booking page.
subject: {{ client_name }} canceled your meeting on {{ date }}

name: Meeting reminder
description: Sent to clients before a confirmed meeting.
subject: Your meeting with {{ advisor_first_name }} is coming up
